TASK: refresh/re-verify this right now, since time has passed:
1. Re-fetch SFCC-51 in full (all comments) - has anything changed? Any NEW comments since the ones already found (13363, 13387)? What is its CURRENT status (was "Blocked")?
2. Re-fetch SFCC-10 (Z.immerse epic) in full - any new comments, any status change, any scope expansion beyond Z.immerse/campaign pages?
3. Fresh broad search: jql text ~ "Experience Builder" OR text ~ "Studio Experience" OR text ~ "component library" OR text ~ "flexible component" OR text ~ "visual editor" OR text ~ "page composition" across ALL issue types, no status filter, ORDER BY created DESC - report every hit, flag anything NOT already known (previously found: SFCC-51, SFCC-10, SFCC-2).
4. Check the Sprint-1 content-type stories again for any NEW comments since last check: SFCC-55 (footer), SFCC-90 (homepage), SFCC-96 (mega menu), SFCC-52 (header) - any new mention of Studio/Experience Builder/drag-and-drop?
5. Check SFCC-249 (the TSD review ticket) for any new comments since 2026-08-01 that touch this specific topic.
6. Search for any NEW ticket created since 2026-08-01 that might address component-authoring strategy, Experience Builder scope, or the drift-risk / component-requirement-pages proposal Tim raised separately.

Report back with explicit VERIFIED/CHANGED/NEW/NO-CHANGE verdicts, citing issue keys and exact quotes/comment IDs. Do not speculate, only report what is directly found.
